environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind AWS Application Load Balancer. The database connection routes through a PgBouncer 1.21 instance running in transaction mode. The PostgreSQL role (product_svc_ro) is configured with column-level SELECT privileges ONLY on the products table (id, name, price, category, stock_count, description, active, created_at columns). No schema-level or table-level grants exist for any other table. Additionally, a pg_hba.conf entry restricts the product_svc_ro role to connections only from the PgBouncer subnet CIDR, and the RDS instance has a custom parameter group with log_min_duration_statement=0 feeding CloudWatch with a metric filter alarm on query patterns touching non-products tables. The RDS instance also uses a Security Group that only allows inbound 5432 from the PgBouncer security group.

config.database_role: product_svc_ro with explicit column-level grants: GRANT SELECT (id, name, price, category, stock_count, description, active, created_at) ON products TO product_svc_ro; NO other grants
config.pg_hba: hostssl products product_svc_ro 10.0.4.0/24 scram-sha-256 (only PgBouncer subnet)
config.security_groups: RDS SG inbound 5432 only from PgBouncer SG; PgBouncer SG inbound 6432 only from ECS tasks SG
